#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    const int MOD = 1000000007;
    int n = 0;
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        std::istringstream iss(line);
        std::string token;
        if (iss >> token) {
            n = std::stoi(token);
            break;
        }
    }

    std::vector<long long> prev(n + 2, 0);
    std::vector<long long> cur(n + 2, 0);
    long long ans = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        int maxD = n - i;
        for (int d = 0; d <= maxD; d++) {
            if (i == 0) {
                cur[d] = 1;
            } else if (d == 0) {
                cur[d] = prev[1];
            } else {
                cur[d] = (cur[d - 1] + prev[d + 1]) % MOD;
            }
            if (d & 1) {
                ans = (ans + cur[d]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        std::swap(prev, cur);
    }

    std::cout << ans << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
